banner: Demo mode: sign-in is disabled. Your checkups are saved only in this browser.

home.intro: Take a photo of a leaf from your crop. We'll tell you what disease it has, how serious it is, what medicine to use, and how much crop you could lose if you wait.
home.exampleAdvice: You could lose 30% of your crop if not treated. Use Propiconazole spray within 5–7 days.
home.step1Desc: Click a clear picture of one leaf in daylight.
home.step2Desc: We check the leaf and tell you the disease.
home.step3Desc: See what to spray and how much crop is at risk.

predict.title: Analyze a leaf
predict.waking: Waking up the model… the first check after a quiet spell can take up to 30 seconds.

upload.browse: drag & drop, or click to browse

history.title: Field log
history.emptyHint: Check a leaf to start your record

result.notReviewed: This Hindi advice has not yet been checked by an agriculture expert. Keep chemical names and doses exactly as written, and confirm with your local agriculture officer.
result.yieldLoss: Estimated loss of {{pct}}% if left untreated.
result.leanings: What the model leaned towards (not a diagnosis)

rejected.title: Photo not clear enough
rejected.message: We could not read this photo well enough to check the leaf. Please take it again.

notLeaf.title: No leaf found
notLeaf.message: This photo does not seem to show a plant leaf. Please photograph the leaf you want checked.

uncertain.title: We're not sure about this one
uncertain.message: This photo doesn't look like the {{crop}} leaves our model has learned from, so we won't guess a disease. Please retake it, or ask a local agriculture officer.

tips.too_small: Use the full camera resolution and move a little closer.
tips.blurry: Hold the phone steady and tap the leaf on screen to focus before taking the photo.
tips.too_dark: Take the photo in daylight, not at night or in deep shade.
tips.too_bright: Avoid harsh direct sun or flash glare. Shade the leaf with your body.
tips.no_leaf: Fill most of the frame with one leaf, about 20–30 cm from the camera.
tips.unreadable_image: The file could not be opened. Try a JPG or PNG photo.
tips.unfamiliar_image: Check that the right crop is selected, then photograph a single leaf of that crop.
tips.low_confidence: Check that the right crop is selected, then photograph a single leaf of that crop.

generalTips.oneLeaf: One leaf, filling most of the frame
